name: Plucked Strings Solenoids
summary: Configurable USB-MIDI plucked-string architecture using solenoids for both fret actuation and alternating string plucking.
description: An older generic guitar/ukulele/bass design built around MCP23017 I/O expansion and solenoid power stages. The repository explicitly says the code compiles but no hardware has been tested.

notes: USB MIDI is documented; the audited README does not assert a final board model.

mechanics.summary: Solenoid fingers pull strings toward frets; two opposed solenoids per string alternate plucking direction and can damp the string when released.
notes: Repository emphasizes damping mechanical noise and reducing coil hold power to manage heat.

actuators.notes: Example configuration uses 12 fret solenoids plus two pluck solenoids per string.

notes: Thermal management is mandatory; repository calls for reduced hold voltage/PWM after activation.

warnings: Repository explicitly states that the code compiles but the physical system has not been tested.
Solenoid heating and hold-power reduction remain important unresolved physical concerns.
